text:
maria: Heads-up — token-service error-rate monitor has been noisy for the past 3 hours, firing ~15 times. Can someone help tune or suggest a short mute during the deploy window?
liam: Thanks for flagging. Do you have the monitor ID / query and a link to the dashboard?
maria: Monitor ID `dd:456789` (Datadog). Dashboard: https://app.datadog.com/dashboard/token-service/errors (team view). Query: `avg(last_1m):sum:token_service.errors{env:prod}.as_count() / sum:token_service.requests{env:prod}.as_count() > 0.01` — spikes from a flaky downstream cache during rollouts.
priya: If it's a rollout spike, we should alert on sustained error rate, e.g. `avg(last_5m) > 0.005` instead of 1m. Also add a `count by` to avoid single-host noise.
samir: Agree. Another option: add a `no-data` / evaluation window of 5m and set notify_no_data:false so it doesn't page during short bursts.
liam: For immediate relief, do we want a temporary mute for the monitor for 30m around the deploy (we have a 10:00 UTC deploy)? I can do that.
maria: Yes please mute for 40m starting 09:55 UTC. Also add a note in the alert body pointing to the runbook: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/token-service-errors
oncall-bot: Monitor dd:456789 triggered 2026-02-14T08:12:34Z — error-rate 1.8% (last_1m).
priya: Suggested final monitor query: `avg(last_5m):sum:token_service.errors{env:prod}.as_count() / sum:token_service.requests{env:prod}.as_count() by {service,region} > 0.005`. Tag aggregation reduces flapping.
samir: Also recommend adding a `suppress during` for the pager rule: `during:any(rolling_deploy_tag)` which ties to our deploy pipeline tags. If that's heavy, at least add a 2-call-oncall threshold (only page after 2 consecutive evals).
liam: I'll open a Datadog monitor edit PR with the change and schedule the mute. Command I'll run: `datadog monitors update 456789 --query "avg(last_5m):..." --notify_no_data false`
maria: thanks — when you schedule the mute, paste the mute-id here so I can link it in the patch notes. :thumbsup:
liam: Mute scheduled: mute_id `m-20260214-09-55`. I also updated the monitor in staging with the new 5m window. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/monitors/pull/178
priya: Nice. After the deploy, let's review last 24h and consider moving to composite: errors + latency > threshold before paging.
samir: Added a small note to the runbook about cache rollout behavior.
maria: Closing loop — noisy alerts reduced after mute and monitor change. Please keep an eye and re-open if it flaps again. :white_check_mark:
